text:
rachel: quick heads-up — planning to enable feature flag `spec_decode_v2` for a 10% canary on prod tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Need runtime + ops signoff and a short smoke plan.

dan: do we know how this interacts with `kv_cache_prefetch`? last time spec decode + aggressive kv prefetch caused memory spikes.

lisa: good call. add a guardrail: abort rollout if p50 token latency delta > 120ms or OOM rate > 0.1%.

matt: I can run a 2k-req perf sweep on my dev cluster tonight. will post numbers by 7pm PT.

sean: pinging @ops — can you reserve the canary audience buckets (10% global) and make sure the rollback playbook is ready?

ops: noted. will create the canary group and a temporary autoscaling cap to control blast radius. Also adding a pre-rollout watch for memory and per-GPU utilization.

rachel: thanks — also, code owners: @dan please review the runtime changes in PR #5231, and @matt please re-run the fuzz tests for kv cache.

dan: on it. small API change to the spec decode scheduler — inline diff:```diff
- func schedule(batch) { ... }
+ func schedule(batch, speculative_hint) { ... }
```

lisa: reminder: add a metric for `spec_decode_rewrites` so we can detect behavioral regressions (we want to ensure same outputs for 95% of prompts).

matt: if we see steady latency regression we'll fallback to `spec_decode_v1` automatically via the rollout policy. can we add that auto-fallback rule to the flag config?

rachel: yes — rollout policy: enable -> monitor(5m) -> if latency_p50_delta > 120ms OR error_rate > 0.5% then rollback to v1. also, route new requests to fallback model variant if kernel fails.

sean: PR #5231 updated with rollout json and canary audience tag `canary_spec_v2`. please review: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/5231

deploy-bot: Schedule created: rollout spec_decode_v2 -> 10% -> 2026-04-02T17:00Z (watch window 5m). CI: green.

rachel: thanks everyone. action items: @matt perf numbers tonight, @dan review + lgtm, @ops set canary buckets + autoscale cap, @lisa add metrics and alert thresholds. I'll coordinate the live watch during rollout.

sean: one more ask — add a quickplaybook snippet in the rollout PR for how to force-disable flag across all clusters: `curl -XPOST /admin/flags/spec_decode_v2/disable -d '{"reason":"rollback"}'`

rachel: good idea — added to the PR comment.

matt: perf numbers posted: no p50 change on my runs, p95 +10ms, mem stable. attaching logs in PR.

dan: reviewed and left minor comments. lgtm after fixes.

lisa: added `spec_decode_rewrites` metric + alert to ops dashboard. threshold = 5% mismatch.

ops: canary buckets ready. autoscale cap = 2x baseline for affected pods. watch monitors in place.

rachel: final call — rolling tomorrow at 10:00 PDT. if anything unexpected, hit the rollback endpoint and @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:

sean: noted. thanks all.

matt: will be standing by during rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: spec_decode_v2 -> 10% (canary_spec_v2).

ops: alert: small spike in p95 at minute 3, currently +45ms, under threshold.

rachel: continuing watch. no action yet.

ops: alert cleared. p95 back to baseline within watch window.

rachel: closing thread — rollout successful and promoting to 50% next week after further validation. :tada:
